name: Rue des Gestes — étape 6 · porter, poser, placer
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so they all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a low stone wall with hedges, no verbs). Tiers: street (hotel porter carrying a tower of suitcases, woman posing as she puts down a vase, traveller returning home with his globe), balcony (man throwing an old boot down into the bin), upper (woman taking off her huge feathered hat), roof (man seating a tabby cat on a chair). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
